versions.content: If the provide activating event feature is enabled, the RTE gen- erator in contract phase shall generate the type SchM_ActivatingEvent_<name> (activation vector) , where <name> is the symbol describing the executable entity's entry point, to store the activation bits. Based on the highest value of Ex- ecutableEntityActivationReason . bitPosition for this executable entity the type shall be either uint8 , uint16 , or uint32 so that the highest value of bitPo- sition fits into the data type.
